Retrieved tables

Source: R/tosi-table.R
tosi_table.Rd

A tosi_table is a tibble with a schema, title, source label, provenance, and result_scope stored as attributes. Check attr(x, "result_scope") before using the rows:

Usage

is_tosi_table(x)

# S3 method for class 'tosi_table'
as_tibble(x, ..., drop_replaced = FALSE)

Arguments

x

Any R object.

...

Arguments passed to tibble::as_tibble().

drop_replaced

If TRUE, omit delivered source columns identified by schema components' replaces_id. Names are derived from the complete embedded schema using the table's stored column mode.

Value

TRUE if x inherits from "tosi_table", FALSE otherwise.

as_tibble() returns an ordinary tibble. Conversion retains ordinary tibble metadata behavior; the schema is not reduced or rebuilt, and no metadata guarantee is made after conversion.

Details

  • "complete": all rows for the request as interpreted by the connector, including filters and defaults. This does not necessarily mean all rows in the source.

  • "preview": intentionally limited rows. Refine the selection using the available connector instructions and check the new result.

Result scope is not a table column or schema component.

attr(x, "schema") is a TosiSchema with the delivered object's $connector_id, $object_id, and $data_version. See names(x) for the actual column names and TosiStructure for mapping component IDs to names. Use provenance() for the result's history. These attributes describe the table as delivered; wrangling may alter or discard them.
